assumptions: flip = metrics/flip.rs::error_map + mean (flip.rs:220-258): LDR-FLIP at reference defaults (0.7 m / 3840 px / 0.7 m -> ppd = 3840*pi/180 ~ 67.02).
Ingress per px per img (flip.rs:70-92): 3 sRGB->linear LUT gathers + xyz() 3x3 (9 mul + 6 add) + INV_WHITE mul3 + Lab terms (l: mul+add; a,b: sub+mul) = mul 15, add 9.

colors() (flip.rs:187-194): per px per img — pad channel p[2]->p[3] (store), then separable conv of 4-ch pixels with spatial_filter: radius = ceil(3*sqrt(0.04/(2pi^2))*ppd) = 10 -> 21 taps per axis (flip.rs:93-124); convolve per tap per ch: mul+add (flip.rs:152-186) -> per pass per elem: 84 mul + 84 add + 84 loads; two passes. Then filtered_lab (flip.rs:45-57): y reconstruct (add+div), q (2 div/mul + add), 3x3 XYZ->RGB + 3 clamps + hunt_lab: xyz 9mul+6add, 3 mul inv-white, 3 f() (cmp + pow common path) + Lab out (mul+add, 2x(mul+mul+sub)).
features() (flip.rs:195-218): per px per img — y reconstruct (mul+add), h conv 3ch x 19 taps (57 mul + 57 add), expand, v conv 4ch x 19 taps (76 mul + 76 add), output: 2x(mul2 add1 sqrt1).

error map per px (flip.rs:236-251): hyab (2 sub + abs + 2 mul + add + sqrt) + powf(0.7) + low-range clamp branch (cmp + ~3 ops) + feature term (2 sub + 2 abs + max cmp + mul + sqrt-powf(0.5)) + powf(1-f): mul~7 add~8 abs3 sqrt2 pow3 cmp4.
cmax = hyab(hunt_lab([0,1,0]), hunt_lab([0,0,1]))^0.7 computed once — negligible.
mean: f64 running sum (cvt+add per elem) + final div; flip-v17 variant not the default column.
